tickets.text: Held: add only on strength, each addition at a higher price than the last (C6); an add on a pullback under the 20-day average is adding into a reaction, which C4 and C5 forbid.
The case is an established trend, not yet a fresh new high (C5): the entry only counts once the trigger prints a new high after the pull-in; a pull-in that fails to make one is not a buy.
